card.name: Inside abbreviations like CrCl and DLBCL
card.fires_on: The final piece of medical abbreviations split into parts, mainly the 'Cl' in CrCl and the 'CL' in DLBCL. It also fires weakly on word pieces such as 'urred' in 'Blurred'.

modes.label: CrCl abbreviation end
modes.description: The 'Cl' that finishes creatinine clearance (CrCl) in renal dosing text.
modes.example: Monitor Cr<<Cl>> at least daily in adult and pediatric patients
